PROP-56ad1eb2-inv-007.text: P256VERIFY must never revert; all invalid inputs return empty output, not an EVM exception.
PROP-56ad1eb2-inv-007.assertion: forall input I: p256verify(I) terminates AND (returns 32-byte result OR returns empty)

locations.note: Returns tuple (byte[], bool) - true in second element means success without revert. ValidResult is 32-byte padded [1], empty array on failure.
